text.WEB: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
text.BSB: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
text.KJV: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

text.WEB: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
text.BSB: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
text.KJV: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

text.WEB: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing. I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treates you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
text.BSB: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing. I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
text.KJV: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

text.WEB: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.
text.BSB: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
text.KJV: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

text.WEB: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah will have a son.”
text.BSB: Is anything too difficult for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you—in about a year—and Sarah will have a son.”
text.KJV: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

text.WEB: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you, until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
text.BSB: Look, I am with you, and I will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.”
text.KJV: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

text.WEB: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is today, to save many people alive.
text.BSB: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.
text.KJV: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

text.WEB: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
text.BSB: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
text.KJV: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

text.WEB: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
text.BSB: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.”
text.KJV: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

text.WEB: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
text.BSB: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
text.KJV: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

text.WEB: “You shall have no other gods before me.
text.BSB: You shall have no other gods before Me.
text.KJV: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

text.WEB: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
text.BSB: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
text.KJV: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

text.WEB: Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,
text.BSB: Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
text.KJV: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

text.WEB: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.
text.BSB: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
text.KJV: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.

text.WEB: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you. Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you. Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’
text.BSB: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you; may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you; may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’
text.KJV: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

text.WEB: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not make it good?
text.BSB: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?
text.KJV: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

text.WEB: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one. You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
text.BSB: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One. And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
text.KJV: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

text.WEB: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them who love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
text.BSB: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.
text.KJV: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

text.WEB: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
text.BSB: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”
text.KJV: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

text.WEB: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”
text.BSB: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.”
text.KJV: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

text.WEB: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
text.BSB: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
text.KJV: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

text.WEB: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
text.BSB: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
text.KJV: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

text.WEB: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”
text.BSB: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”
text.KJV: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!”
text.BSB: And the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon and said, “The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.”
text.KJV: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

text.WEB: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
text.BSB: But Ruth replied: “Do not urge me to leave you or to turn from following you. For wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you live, I will live; your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.
text.KJV: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

text.WEB: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, For there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.
text.BSB: There is no one holy like the LORD. Indeed, there is no one besides You! And there is no Rock like our God.
text.KJV: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.

text.WEB: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”
text.BSB: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.”
text.KJV: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

text.WEB: and that all this assembly may know that Yahweh doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is Yahweh’s, and he will give you into our hand.”
text.BSB: And all those assembled here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the LORD saves; for the battle is the LORD’s, and He will give all of you into our hands.”
text.KJV: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’S, and he will give you into our hands.

text.WEB: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
text.BSB: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
text.KJV: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

text.WEB: “Blessed be Yahweh, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.
text.BSB: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to His people Israel according to all that He promised. Not one word has failed of all the good promises He made through His servant Moses.
text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

text.WEB: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
text.BSB: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
text.KJV: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.

text.WEB: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text.BSB: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.WEB: Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all.
text.BSB: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
text.KJV: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.

text.WEB: if my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
text.BSB: and if My people who are called by My name humble themselves and pray and seek My face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.
text.KJV: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

text.WEB: For Yahweh’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”
text.BSB: For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him. You have acted foolishly in this matter. From now on, therefore, you will be at war.”
text.KJV: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

text.WEB: For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.
text.BSB: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach its statutes and ordinances in Israel.
text.KJV: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

text.WEB: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”
text.BSB: Then Nehemiah told them, “Go and eat what is rich, drink what is sweet, and send out portions to those who have nothing prepared, since today is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
text.KJV: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

text.WEB: You are Yahweh, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.
text.BSB: You alone are the LORD. You created the heavens, the highest heavens with all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to all things, and the host of heaven worships You.
text.KJV: Thou, even thou, art LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.

text.WEB: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”
text.BSB: For if you remain silent at this time, relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. And who knows if perhaps you have come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”
text.KJV: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

text.WEB: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away. Blessed be Yahweh’s name.”
text.BSB: saying: “Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will return. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the name of the LORD.”
text.KJV: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.

text.WEB: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
text.BSB: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.
text.KJV: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

text.WEB: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
text.BSB: “I know that You can do all things and that no plan of Yours can be thwarted.
text.KJV: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

text.WEB: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers; but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
text.BSB: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers. But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
text.KJV: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

text.WEB: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
text.BSB: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
text.KJV: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

text.WEB: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
text.BSB: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
text.KJV: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

text.WEB: Yahweh, in the morning you shall hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
text.BSB: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
text.KJV: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

text.WEB: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained; what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
text.BSB: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place— what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
text.KJV: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained; What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

text.WEB: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble. Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
text.BSB: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble. Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
text.KJV: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble. And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

text.WEB: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
text.BSB: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
text.KJV: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

text.WEB: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
text.BSB: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
text.KJV: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

text.WEB: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
text.BSB: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
text.KJV: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

text.WEB: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
text.BSB: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
text.KJV: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

text.WEB: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
text.BSB: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
text.KJV: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

text.WEB: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
text.BSB: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
text.KJV: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

text.WEB: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
text.BSB: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
text.KJV: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

text.WEB: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths. Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
text.BSB: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths. Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
text.KJV: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths. Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

text.WEB: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
text.BSB: The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
text.KJV: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

text.WEB: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
text.BSB: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
text.KJV: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

text.WEB: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
text.BSB: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
text.KJV: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

text.WEB: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
text.BSB: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
text.KJV: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

text.WEB: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
text.BSB: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
text.KJV: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

text.WEB: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
text.BSB: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
text.KJV: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

text.WEB: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
text.BSB: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
text.KJV: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

text.WEB: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
text.BSB: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.
text.KJV: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.

text.WEB: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
text.BSB: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
text.KJV: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

text.WEB: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
text.BSB: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
text.KJV: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

text.WEB: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
text.BSB: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
text.KJV: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

text.WEB: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
text.BSB: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
text.KJV: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

text.WEB: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
text.BSB: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
text.KJV: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

text.WEB: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
text.BSB: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
text.KJV: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

text.WEB: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
text.BSB: I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.
text.KJV: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

text.WEB: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
text.BSB: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
text.KJV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

text.WEB: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
text.BSB: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
text.KJV: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

text.WEB: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
text.BSB: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
text.KJV: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

text.WEB: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
text.BSB: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
text.KJV: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

text.WEB: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
text.BSB: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
text.KJV: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

text.WEB: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
text.BSB: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
text.KJV: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

text.WEB: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
text.BSB: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
text.KJV: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

text.WEB: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him. He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress— I will never be greatly shaken.
text.BSB: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him. He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
text.KJV: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation. He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

text.WEB: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
text.BSB: O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
text.KJV: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

text.WEB: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
text.BSB: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
text.KJV: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

text.WEB: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
text.BSB: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
text.KJV: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

text.WEB: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
text.BSB: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
text.KJV: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

text.WEB: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
text.BSB: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
text.KJV: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

text.WEB: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
text.BSB: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
text.KJV: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

text.WEB: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
text.BSB: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
text.KJV: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

text.WEB: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
text.BSB: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
text.KJV: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

text.WEB: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
text.BSB: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
text.KJV: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

text.WEB: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
text.BSB: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
text.KJV: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

text.WEB: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,
text.BSB: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
text.KJV: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

text.WEB: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name. For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
text.BSB: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name. For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
text.KJV: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name. For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

text.WEB: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits;
text.BSB: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—
text.KJV: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

text.WEB: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him. As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
text.BSB: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him. As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
text.KJV: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him. As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

text.WEB: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
text.BSB: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.WEB: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
text.BSB: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
text.KJV: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

text.WEB: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
text.BSB: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
text.KJV: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.

text.WEB: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
text.BSB: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
text.KJV: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

text.WEB: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
text.BSB: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
text.KJV: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

text.WEB: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
text.BSB: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
text.KJV: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

text.WEB: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
text.BSB: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
text.KJV: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

text.WEB: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
text.BSB: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
text.KJV: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

text.WEB: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
text.BSB: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
text.KJV: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

text.WEB: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
text.BSB: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come? My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
text.KJV: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

text.WEB: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul. Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
text.BSB: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul. The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
text.KJV: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

text.WEB: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
text.BSB: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
text.KJV: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

text.WEB: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they labor in vain who build it. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
text.BSB: Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
text.KJV: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

text.WEB: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
text.BSB: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
text.KJV: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

text.WEB: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
text.BSB: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.WEB: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb. I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
text.BSB: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb. I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
text.KJV: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb. I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

text.WEB: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
text.BSB: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns. See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
text.KJV: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

text.WEB: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
text.BSB: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
text.KJV: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

text.WEB: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
text.BSB: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
text.KJV: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

text.WEB: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
text.BSB: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
text.KJV: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

text.WEB: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
text.BSB: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
text.KJV: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

text.WEB: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
text.BSB: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
text.KJV: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
text.BSB: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

text.WEB: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
text.BSB: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
text.KJV: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

text.WEB: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:
text.BSB: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your harvest;
text.KJV: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

text.WEB: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
text.BSB: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
text.KJV: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
text.BSB: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

text.WEB: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
text.BSB: A generous soul will prosper, and he who refreshes others will himself be refreshed.
text.KJV: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

text.WEB: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
text.BSB: Anxiety weighs down the heart of a man, but a good word cheers it up.
text.KJV: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

text.WEB: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
text.BSB: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
text.KJV: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

text.WEB: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
text.BSB: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
text.KJV: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

text.WEB: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
text.BSB: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
text.KJV: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

text.WEB: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
text.BSB: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
text.KJV: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

text.WEB: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
text.BSB: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
text.KJV: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

text.WEB: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
text.BSB: Many plans are in a man’s heart, but the purpose of the LORD will prevail.
text.KJV: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.

text.WEB: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
text.BSB: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
text.KJV: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

text.WEB: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
text.BSB: As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.
text.KJV: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

text.WEB: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
text.BSB: Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
text.KJV: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

text.WEB: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
text.BSB: Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting, but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.
text.KJV: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.

text.WEB: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
text.BSB: To everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
text.KJV: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

text.WEB: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
text.BSB: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
text.KJV: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

text.WEB: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
text.BSB: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor. For if one falls down, his companion can lift him up; but pity the one who falls without another to help him up!
text.KJV: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

text.WEB: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God, and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.
text.BSB: When all has been heard, the conclusion of the matter is this: Fear God and keep His commandments, because this is the whole duty of man.
text.KJV: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

text.WEB: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
text.BSB: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying: “Whom shall I send? Who will go for Us?” And I said: “Here am I. Send me!”
text.KJV: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

text.WEB: For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
text.BSB: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
text.KJV: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

text.WEB: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
text.BSB: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
text.KJV: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.

text.WEB: Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
text.BSB: O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago— in perfect faithfulness.
text.KJV: O LORD, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.

text.WEB: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
text.BSB: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
text.KJV: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

text.WEB: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
text.BSB: Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
text.KJV: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:

text.WEB: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,
text.BSB: For the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said: “By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence— but you were not willing.”
text.KJV: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

text.WEB: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.
text.BSB: Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
text.KJV: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.

text.WEB: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”
text.BSB: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God stands forever.”
text.KJV: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

text.WEB: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, The Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable. He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
text.BSB: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out. He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.
text.KJV: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding. He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

text.WEB: But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
text.BSB: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
text.KJV: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

text.WEB: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
text.BSB: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.
text.KJV: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

text.WEB: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
text.BSB: For I am the LORD your God, who takes hold of your right hand and tells you: Do not fear, I will help you.
text.KJV: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

text.WEB: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
text.BSB: Now this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
text.KJV: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

text.WEB: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
text.BSB: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.
text.KJV: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

text.WEB: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
text.BSB: “Do not call to mind the former things; pay no attention to the things of old. Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
text.KJV: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

text.WEB: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you! Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. your walls are continually before me.
text.BSB: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, or lack compassion for the son of her womb? Even if she could forget, I will not forget you! Behold, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; your walls are ever before Me.
text.KJV: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee. Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

text.WEB: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
text.BSB: But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.
text.KJV: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

text.WEB: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
text.BSB: We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
text.KJV: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

text.WEB: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed; but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.
text.BSB: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken, My loving devotion will not depart from you, and My covenant of peace will not be broken,” says the LORD, who has compassion on you.
text.KJV: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.

text.WEB: Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
text.BSB: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.
text.KJV: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:

text.WEB: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh. “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
text.BSB: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD. “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so My ways are higher than your ways and My thoughts than your thoughts.
text.KJV: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

text.WEB: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.
text.BSB: so My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.
text.KJV: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

text.WEB: and Yahweh will guide you continually, and satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong; and you shall be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters don’t fail.
text.BSB: The LORD will always guide you; He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land and strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
text.KJV: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

text.WEB: The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me; because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and release to those who are bound;
text.BSB: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,
text.KJV: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;

text.WEB: But now, Yahweh, you are our Father. We are the clay, and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.
text.BSB: But now, O LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are the potter; we are all the work of Your hand.
text.KJV: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

text.WEB: “Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh. For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green; and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.
text.BSB: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him. He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots toward the stream. It does not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves are always green. It does not worry in a year of drought, nor does it cease to produce fruit.
text.KJV: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is. For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

text.WEB: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
text.BSB: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.
text.KJV: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

text.WEB: You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
text.BSB: You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
text.KJV: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

text.WEB: Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.
text.BSB: The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying: “I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with loving devotion.
text.KJV: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

text.WEB: “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you,
text.BSB: “Oh, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for You!
text.KJV: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:

text.WEB: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
text.BSB: Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
text.KJV: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

text.WEB: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
text.BSB: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
text.KJV: It is of the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

text.WEB: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
text.BSB: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
text.KJV: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

text.WEB: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
text.BSB: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
text.KJV: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

text.WEB: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his. He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings, and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding.
text.BSB: and declared: “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever, for wisdom and power belong to Him. He changes the times and seasons; He removes kings and establishes them. He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to the discerning.
text.KJV: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:

text.WEB: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”
text.BSB: If the God whom we serve exists, then He is able to deliver us from the blazing fiery furnace and from your hand, O king. But even if He does not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden statue you have set up.”
text.KJV: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king. But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

text.WEB: Let us acknowledge Yahweh. Let us press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”
text.BSB: So let us know— let us press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, He will appear; He will come to us like the rain, like the spring showers that water the earth.
text.KJV: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

text.WEB: Tear your heart, and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.
text.BSB: So rend your hearts and not your garments, and return to the LORD your God. For He is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion. And He relents from sending disaster.
text.KJV: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

text.WEB: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you.
text.BSB: I will repay you for the years eaten by locusts— the swarming locust, the young locust, the destroying locust, and the devouring locust — My great army that I sent against you.
text.KJV: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

text.WEB: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
text.BSB: But let justice roll on like a river, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
text.KJV: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

text.WEB: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
text.BSB: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
text.KJV: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

text.WEB: But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
text.BSB: But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
text.KJV: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.

text.WEB: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
text.BSB: Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
text.KJV: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

text.WEB: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
text.BSB: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
text.KJV: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

text.WEB: For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food; the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls: yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
text.BSB: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls, yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
text.KJV: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

text.WEB: Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
text.BSB: GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
text.KJV: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

text.WEB: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
text.BSB: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
text.KJV: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

text.WEB: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Yahweh. ‘Be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says Yahweh, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
text.BSB: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel, declares the LORD. Be strong, O Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. And be strong, all you people of the land, declares the LORD. Work! For I am with you, declares the LORD of Hosts.
text.KJV: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:

text.WEB: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
text.BSB: So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.
text.KJV: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.

text.WEB: “For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
text.BSB: “Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
text.KJV: For I am the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

text.WEB: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.’”
text.BSB: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”
text.KJV: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

text.WEB: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
text.BSB: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
text.KJV: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

text.WEB: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven. Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
text.BSB: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
text.KJV: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

text.WEB: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.
text.BSB: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
text.KJV: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

text.WEB: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
text.BSB: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
text.KJV: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

text.WEB: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
text.BSB: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
text.KJV: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

text.WEB: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
