text.BSB: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
text.KJV: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

text.WEB: Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
text.BSB: In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.
text.KJV: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

text.WEB: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
text.BSB: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
text.KJV: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

text.WEB: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret, and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
text.BSB: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
text.KJV: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

text.WEB: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal; but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal; for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
text.BSB: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal. But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal. For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
text.KJV: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

text.WEB: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
text.BSB: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns—and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
text.KJV: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

text.WEB: But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
text.BSB: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
text.KJV: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

text.WEB: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
text.BSB: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
text.KJV: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

text.WEB: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
text.BSB: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
text.KJV: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

text.WEB: Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
text.BSB: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
text.KJV: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

text.WEB: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house on a rock.
text.BSB: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
text.KJV: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

text.WEB: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
text.BSB: Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.”
text.KJV: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few; Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.

text.WEB: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls on the ground apart from your Father’s will, but the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
text.BSB: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father. And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
text.KJV: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father. But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

text.WEB: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
text.BSB: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
text.KJV: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

text.WEB: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
text.BSB: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
text.KJV: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

text.WEB: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
text.BSB: Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
text.KJV: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

text.WEB: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
text.BSB: What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
text.KJV: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

text.WEB: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
text.BSB: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”
text.KJV: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

text.WEB: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
text.BSB: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
text.KJV: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’ This is the first and great commandment. A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
text.BSB: Jesus declared, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’ This is the first and greatest commandment. And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
text.KJV: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment. And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

text.WEB: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
text.BSB: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
text.KJV: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

text.WEB: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
text.BSB: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
text.KJV: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

text.WEB: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
text.BSB: “The time is fulfilled,” He said, “and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!”
text.KJV: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

text.WEB: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
text.BSB: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?
text.KJV: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
text.BSB: “If You can?” echoed Jesus. “All things are possible to him who believes!”
text.KJV: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

text.WEB: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
text.BSB: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God.”
text.KJV: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

text.WEB: For the Son of Man also came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
text.BSB: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
text.KJV: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

text.WEB: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
text.BSB: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
text.KJV: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall havethem.

text.WEB: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.
text.BSB: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’
text.KJV: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

text.WEB: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
text.BSB: For no word from God will ever fail.”
text.KJV: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

text.WEB: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord. My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
text.BSB: Then Mary said: “My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!
text.KJV: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord, And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

text.WEB: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people. For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
text.BSB: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
text.KJV: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

text.WEB: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you, bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
text.BSB: But to those of you who will listen, I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you, bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.
text.KJV: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you, Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

text.WEB: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
text.BSB: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
text.KJV: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

text.WEB: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
text.BSB: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.”
text.KJV: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

text.WEB: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
text.BSB: Then Jesus said to all of them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.
text.KJV: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

text.WEB: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
text.BSB: So I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
text.KJV: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

text.WEB: Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
text.BSB: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom.
text.KJV: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

text.WEB: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
text.BSB: In the same way, I tell you that there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent.
text.KJV: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

text.WEB: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
text.BSB: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”
text.KJV: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

text.WEB: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
text.BSB: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
text.KJV: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

text.WEB: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
text.BSB: The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
text.KJV: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

text.WEB: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
text.BSB: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—
text.KJV: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

text.WEB: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
text.BSB: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
text.KJV: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

text.WEB: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
text.BSB: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
text.KJV: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

text.WEB: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
text.BSB: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
text.KJV: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

text.WEB: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
text.BSB: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.”
text.KJV: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

text.WEB: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
text.BSB: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
text.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

text.WEB: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.
text.BSB: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
text.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

text.WEB: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
text.BSB: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
text.KJV: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

text.WEB: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples. You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
text.BSB: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples. Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
text.KJV: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed; And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

text.WEB: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
text.BSB: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
text.KJV: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

text.WEB: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
text.BSB: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.
text.KJV: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

text.WEB: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
text.BSB: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
text.KJV: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

text.WEB: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
text.BSB: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me. I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
text.KJV: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

text.WEB: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies. Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
text.BSB: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies. And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”
text.KJV: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

text.WEB: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another. By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
text.BSB: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another. By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”
text.KJV: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another. By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

text.WEB: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
text.BSB: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
text.KJV: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

text.WEB: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you. If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
text.BSB: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you? And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
text.KJV: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you. And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
text.BSB: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
text.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

text.WEB: If you love me, keep my commandments.
text.BSB: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
text.KJV: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

text.WEB: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
text.BSB: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
text.KJV: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

text.WEB: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
text.BSB: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
text.KJV: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

text.WEB: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you. Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
text.BSB: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you. Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
text.KJV: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you. Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

text.WEB: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
text.BSB: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
text.KJV: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

text.WEB: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
text.BSB: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
text.KJV: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

text.WEB: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed.”
text.BSB: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
text.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

text.WEB: but these are written, that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
text.BSB: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
text.KJV: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

text.WEB: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
text.BSB: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
text.KJV: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

text.WEB: Peter said to them, “Repent, and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
text.BSB: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
text.KJV: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

text.WEB: There is salvation in none other, for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
text.BSB: Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.”
text.KJV: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

text.WEB: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
text.BSB: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.”
text.KJV: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

text.WEB: ‘For in him we live, and move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
text.BSB: ‘For in Him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are His offspring.’
text.KJV: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

text.WEB: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.
text.BSB: But I consider my life of no value to me, if only I may finish my course and complete the ministry I have received from the Lord Jesus—the ministry of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
text.KJV: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

text.WEB: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”
text.BSB: In everything, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus Himself: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”
text.KJV: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

text.WEB: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes; for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
text.BSB: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek.
text.KJV: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

text.WEB: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God; being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;
text.BSB: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God, and are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God; Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

text.WEB: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
text.BSB: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
text.KJV: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

text.WEB: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
text.BSB: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.
text.KJV: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

text.WEB: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
text.BSB: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
text.KJV: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

text.WEB: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text.BSB: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text.KJV: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

text.WEB: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
text.BSB: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

text.WEB: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
text.BSB: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
text.KJV: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

text.WEB: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
text.BSB: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
text.KJV: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

text.WEB: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.
text.BSB: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
text.KJV: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

text.WEB: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
text.BSB: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
text.KJV: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

text.WEB: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text.BSB: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers, neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text.KJV: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text.WEB: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
text.BSB: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
text.KJV: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

text.WEB: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
text.BSB: for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
text.KJV: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

text.WEB: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
text.BSB: Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
text.KJV: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

text.WEB: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
text.BSB: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
text.KJV: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

text.WEB: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
text.BSB: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
text.KJV: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

text.WEB: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
text.BSB: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
text.KJV: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

text.WEB: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another;
text.BSB: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.
text.KJV: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

text.WEB: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;
text.BSB: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.
text.KJV: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

text.WEB: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
text.BSB: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
text.KJV: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

text.WEB: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
text.BSB: For everything that was written in the past was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures, we might have hope.
text.KJV: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

text.WEB: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
text.BSB: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
text.KJV: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

text.WEB: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are saved it is the power of God.
text.BSB: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
text.KJV: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.

text.WEB: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
text.BSB: Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”
text.KJV: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.

text.WEB: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own, for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
text.BSB: Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own; you were bought at a price. Therefore glorify God with your body.
text.KJV: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.

text.WEB: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
text.BSB: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.
text.KJV: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

text.WEB: Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
text.BSB: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.
text.KJV: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

text.WEB: Love is patient and is kind; love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud, doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
text.BSB: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.
text.KJV: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up, Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;

text.WEB: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
text.BSB: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.
text.KJV: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

text.WEB: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
text.BSB: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
text.KJV: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures; And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

text.WEB: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
text.BSB: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
text.KJV: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

text.WEB: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
text.BSB: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
text.KJV: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

text.WEB: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong! Let all that you do be done in love.
text.BSB: Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong. Do everything in love.
text.KJV: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong. Let all your things be done with charity.

text.WEB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort; who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
text.BSB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.
text.KJV: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort; Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

text.WEB: Now the Lord is the Spirit and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
text.BSB: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
text.KJV: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

text.WEB: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
text.BSB: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
text.KJV: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

text.WEB: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory; while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
text.BSB: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal glory that is far beyond comparison. So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.
text.KJV: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory; While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

text.WEB: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
text.BSB: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
text.KJV: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

text.WEB: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
text.BSB: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
text.KJV: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

text.WEB: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
text.BSB: God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.
text.KJV: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

text.WEB: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart; not grudgingly, or under compulsion; for God loves a cheerful giver.
text.BSB: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. For God loves a cheerful giver.
text.KJV: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

text.WEB: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
text.BSB: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
text.KJV: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

text.WEB: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
text.BSB: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
text.KJV: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

text.WEB: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I that live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
text.BSB: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
text.KJV: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

text.WEB: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
text.BSB: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
text.KJV: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

text.WEB: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
text.BSB: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
text.KJV: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

text.WEB: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
text.BSB: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
text.KJV: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

text.WEB: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.
text.BSB: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
text.KJV: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

text.WEB: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,
text.BSB: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
text.KJV: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

text.WEB: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, that no one would boast.
text.BSB: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God, not by works, so that no one can boast.
text.KJV: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

text.WEB: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
text.BSB: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
text.KJV: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

text.WEB: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us, to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.
text.BSB: Now to Him who is able to do so much more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us, to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
text.KJV: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us, Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

text.WEB: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love; being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
text.BSB: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love, and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.
text.KJV: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love; Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

text.WEB: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
text.BSB: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
text.KJV: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

text.WEB: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
text.BSB: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
text.KJV: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

text.WEB: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children. Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
text.BSB: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children, and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
text.KJV: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children; And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

text.WEB: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
text.BSB: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
text.KJV: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

text.WEB: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
text.BSB: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

text.WEB: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
text.BSB: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
text.KJV: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

text.WEB: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself; each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
text.BSB: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves. Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.
text.KJV: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves. Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

text.WEB: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
text.BSB: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
text.KJV: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

text.WEB: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do. Forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before, I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
text.BSB: Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead, I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

text.WEB: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ;
text.BSB: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
text.KJV: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

text.WEB: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
text.BSB: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
text.KJV: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

text.WEB: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
text.BSB: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

text.WEB: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think about these things.
text.BSB: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.
text.KJV: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

text.WEB: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
text.BSB: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
text.KJV: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

text.WEB: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
text.BSB: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
text.KJV: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

text.WEB: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
text.BSB: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

text.WEB: For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him, and for him. He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
text.BSB: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him. He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
text.KJV: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

text.WEB: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him, rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
text.BSB: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him, rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
text.KJV: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

text.WEB: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
text.BSB: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
text.KJV: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

text.WEB: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
text.BSB: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
text.KJV: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

text.WEB: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
text.BSB: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
text.KJV: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

text.WEB: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.
text.BSB: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
text.KJV: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

text.WEB: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
text.BSB: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
text.KJV: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

text.WEB: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,
text.BSB: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men,
text.KJV: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

text.WEB: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;
text.BSB: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful,
text.KJV: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

text.WEB: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
text.BSB: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
text.KJV: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

text.WEB: Rejoice always. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
text.BSB: Rejoice at all times. Pray without ceasing. Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

text.WEB: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
text.BSB: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
text.KJV: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

text.WEB: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you, and guard you from the evil one.
text.BSB: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
text.KJV: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

text.WEB: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
text.BSB: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
text.KJV: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

text.WEB: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
text.BSB: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
text.KJV: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

text.WEB: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
text.BSB: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
text.KJV: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

text.WEB: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
text.BSB: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
text.KJV: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

text.WEB: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
text.BSB: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
text.KJV: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

text.WEB: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
text.BSB: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
text.KJV: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

text.WEB: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness, that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
text.BSB: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness, so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
text.KJV: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

text.WEB: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
text.BSB: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
text.KJV: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

text.WEB: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men, instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
text.BSB: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone. It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
text.KJV: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

text.WEB: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
text.BSB: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
text.KJV: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

text.WEB: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
text.BSB: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
text.KJV: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

text.WEB: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin. Let us therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.
text.BSB: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin. Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
text.KJV: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin. Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

text.WEB: let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
text.BSB: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.
text.KJV: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

text.WEB: Let us consider how to provoke one another to love and good works, not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another; and so much the more, as you see the Day approaching.
text.BSB: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds. Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
text.KJV: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

text.WEB: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
text.BSB: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.
text.KJV: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

text.WEB: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
text.BSB: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
text.KJV: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

text.WEB: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with perseverance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
text.BSB: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us. Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
text.KJV: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us, Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

text.WEB: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.
text.BSB: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.
text.KJV: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

text.WEB: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
text.BSB: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”
text.KJV: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

text.WEB: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
text.BSB: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
text.KJV: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

text.WEB: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
text.BSB: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.
text.KJV: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

text.WEB: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.
text.BSB: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
text.KJV: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

text.WEB: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.
text.BSB: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
text.KJV: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

text.WEB: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
text.BSB: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
text.KJV: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

text.WEB: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
text.BSB: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
