text.KJV: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

text.WEB: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
text.BSB: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
text.KJV: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

text.WEB: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
text.BSB: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
text.KJV: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

text.WEB: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
text.BSB: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
text.KJV: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

text.WEB: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
text.BSB: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
text.KJV: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

text.WEB: Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
text.BSB: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.
text.KJV: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

text.WEB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
text.BSB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
text.KJV: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

text.WEB: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light:
text.BSB: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
text.KJV: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

text.WEB: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts; and always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear:
text.BSB: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
text.KJV: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

text.WEB: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
text.BSB: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
text.KJV: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

text.WEB: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
text.BSB: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
text.KJV: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

text.WEB: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time; casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
text.BSB: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you. Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
text.KJV: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

text.WEB: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
text.BSB: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
text.KJV: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

text.WEB: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue;
text.BSB: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
text.KJV: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

text.WEB: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but is patient with us, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
text.BSB: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
text.KJV: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

text.WEB: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
text.BSB: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
text.KJV: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

text.WEB: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.
text.BSB: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
text.KJV: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

text.WEB: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
text.BSB: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
text.KJV: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

text.WEB: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
text.BSB: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
text.KJV: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

text.WEB: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
text.BSB: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
text.KJV: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

text.WEB: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
text.BSB: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
text.KJV: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

text.WEB: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God.
text.BSB: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
text.KJV: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

text.WEB: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him. In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
text.BSB: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him. And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
text.KJV: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him. Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

text.WEB: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
text.BSB: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
text.KJV: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

text.WEB: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
text.BSB: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
text.KJV: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

text.WEB: We love him, because he first loved us.
text.BSB: We love because He first loved us.
text.KJV: We love him, because he first loved us.

text.WEB: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
text.BSB: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
text.KJV: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

text.WEB: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
text.BSB: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
text.KJV: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

text.WEB: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
text.BSB: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
text.KJV: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

text.WEB: I have no greater joy than this, to hear about my children walking in truth.
text.BSB: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
text.KJV: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

text.WEB: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy, to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
text.BSB: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy— to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
text.KJV: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy, To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

text.WEB: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
text.BSB: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty.
text.KJV: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

text.WEB: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.
text.BSB: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
text.KJV: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

text.WEB: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.”
text.BSB: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.”
text.KJV: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

text.WEB: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
text.BSB: And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”
text.KJV: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

text.WEB: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
text.BSB: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”
text.KJV: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
